subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked candidate's split between strict effective room_event delivery and a session-stable prompt/tool contract, including the safe owner-only tool inventory for ambient room events?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the candidate repair changes owner-visible room_event tool availability and provider prompt-boundary shape, which need maintainer product/security-boundary intent before closure.

options.title: Accept stable room_event policy after PR fixes
options.body: Keep strict message-tool-only delivery for room events while allowing the prompt/tool surface to stay session-stable once the PR proof and remaining review blocker are addressed.

options.title: Preserve owner room-event tools
options.body: Require a different fix that keeps owner-only tools available to owner-sent ambient room_event turns even if that needs another cache-stability strategy.

options.title: Document strict behavior only
options.body: Reject the runtime stabilization and document the prompt-cache tradeoff as part of the ambient room_event contract.

recommendation.title: Accept stable room_event policy after PR fixes
recommendation.body: Keep strict message-tool-only delivery for room events while allowing the prompt/tool surface to stay session-stable once the PR proof and remaining review blocker are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy history from the merged visible-reply work.
